5.3.name: JAM.BestChain.ancestry
5.3.note: within the node's store: P is `JAM.BestChain.lookup`, and a parent is followed only while it is known and has a smaller timeslot; block import keeps 𝐀 as the retained headers `JAM.Chain`, assumed (not checked) to form a parent chain

5.8.name: JAM.BestChain.slotTimely
5.8.note: block import checks P(H)_T < H_T as τ < H_T (Safrole's `badSlot`); the best-chain functions use it only to stop following parents in `JAM.BestChain.ancestry`; the wall-clock bound is checked nowhere

19.2.name: JAM.BestChain.acceptable
19.2.note: the `head` reading is the formula; `chain` also asks every unfinalized ancestor to be audited (note v0.8.1-A21)

19.3.name: JAM.BestChain.acceptable
19.3.note: 𝐀(𝐇^♮) is `F`, from `JAM.BestChain.finalizedAncestors`; 𝐇^B ranges over the whole store (`JAM.BestChain.equivocates`, note v0.8.1-A23)

19.4.name: JAM.BestChain.metric
19.4.note: counts the ancestors in the store (note v0.8.1-A25); 𝐓 is `ticketed`, from `JAM.BestChain.ticketedOf`
